title: user.identity_roles — Identity & Roles Pack Record
description: Schema for a single record in the user.identity_roles pack (pack #1 of 14): who the subject is, the roles they hold, the contexts those roles apply in, and how identity statements are attributed. Extends the unified base record via allOf $ref to ./record.base.schema.json and narrows record_type to this pack's four types. Routed from IdentityRoleCandidate (see spec/01-kernel-schema.md §6). Pack definition: spec/03-pack-catalog.md (user.identity_roles); base record: spec/01-kernel-schema.md §7.

record_type.description: Identity/roles record type. RoleRecord: a role or identity the subject holds (founder, reviewer, parent). ContextRecord: a setting/audience/project context that activates a role. AttributionRecord: who/what an identity claim is attributed to, including founder attribution. ScopeRecord: an explicit scope/condition boundary delimiting when a role or identity statement is in effect.

role_name.description: Canonical name of the role or identity (e.g. 'founder', 'code reviewer', 'mentor'). Primarily for RoleRecord; display convenience over the base `label`.

role_kind.description: Coarse classification of the role/identity, used for retrieval and overlay selection.

context_domains.description: Contexts/audiences/projects in which this role or identity is active (e.g. ['open-source maintainership', '1:1 mentoring']). Primarily for ContextRecord; complements base `linked_domains`.

attributed_to.description: Subject/person/entity the identity claim is attributed to. Preserves founder attribution where required (e.g. 'Logotekton founded the Personal Agent project'). Primarily for AttributionRecord.

scope_conditions.description: Explicit conditions that must hold for the role/identity to apply (e.g. 'only when acting as repo owner', 'not in client-facing comms'). Primarily for ScopeRecord; refines the required base `scope` into checkable clauses (Gate G2).

active_status.description: Whether the role/identity is currently held. Distinguishes a present role from a past or aspirational one so the runtime does not speak from a role the subject no longer occupies.

supersedes_role.description: Id of an earlier identity/role record this one replaces (e.g. a former title). Pairs with base `supersedes`; surfaced here for the common role-change case feeding user.drift_history.

$comment: Required fields are inherited unchanged from record.base.schema.json (id, record_type, label, statement, evidence_refs, confidence, scope, review_status, sensitivity, created_at, updated_at). All fields added here are OPTIONAL. record_type is constrained to the four user.identity_roles types. Identity records that touch personal/civic identity often warrant sensitivity ≥ internal and a BoundaryRule before promotion (Gate G5).
